customers_say: Customers find the water purifier excellent in quality and performance, with smooth installation and easy connection. The water quality receives positive feedback, with the app clearly showing purification status, and customers appreciate its premium appearance and good taste. While the service offers 2 years of hassle-free maintenance, several customers report that their units stopped working within one month of use.

reviews.author: mohammed ghiya
reviews.title: Excellent water purifier with premium features
reviews.body: I recently purchased the Native M2 Pro from Amazon and overall I’m very satisfied with the product. The design looks premium and modern, and the touch controls make dispensing water very convenient. The water purification performance has been excellent so far, and the water tastes clean and fresh. I particularly like the smart features and the Urban Company app, where you can monitor the purifier, filter status and water usage. The installation experience was also smooth.

reviews.author: Dinesh
reviews.title: Value for money and quality of water is good.
reviews.body: Product delivery took some time, but installation took place on the second day, installation process was smooth, technician done a wonderful job. Found continuous leakage from the tank after installation, same was fixed the next day by technician. Purifier is very silent, easy to setup with wifi and to connect with phone. Quality of water is good and very tasty, tds level came down to around 40-50 ppm. Got inbuilt battery just to dispense water incase of power cut, purifier doesn't run with that battery. reviews.author: Wajid khan
reviews.title: Native M2 pro
reviews.body: This water purifier is an absolute game-changer for our home! We've been using it daily, and the water quality is consistently excellent. It's so reassuring knowing our family is drinking clean and healthy water. The ease of use is also a huge plus; it fits seamlessly into our daily routine. I highly recommend this for anyone looking for a reliable solution for their household water needs. It's around 1300 TDS in my area, and it purifies to 85 to 100, which is a good level for drinking.

reviews.author: gowtham chama
reviews.title: My Review of the Native M2 Neo Pro Water Purifier by Urban Company
reviews.body: ’ve been using the Native M2 Neo Pro Water Purifier by Urban Company for the past month, and I’m genuinely satisfied with the product. One of the biggest reasons I chose this purifier is its excellent RO filtration. The water in my area has a TDS of around 1,000, and this purifier consistently brings it down to around 50 TDS, providing clean, safe, and great-tasting drinking water. The difference in water quality is noticeable, and the taste is excellent. The purifier has a modern, premium design, and the touch controls are responsive and easy to use.
